card.name: Section numbers in label cross-references
card.fires_on: The first digit of a numbered label section such as 2.3 or 5.5, just before the decimal point. It appears in section headings and in cross-references like [see Dosage and Administration (2.1)].

modes.label: Section heading digit
modes.description: The leading digit of a new numbered section heading that starts right after a sentence ends.

modes.label: Cross-reference digit
modes.description: The leading digit of a section number inside parentheses or brackets pointing to another section.
